title: melicoccus oliviformis subsp. intermedius
intro: Melicoccus oliviformis subsp. intermedius, commonly known as the Panama berry, is a plant species of the Sapindaceae family. It is native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The Panama berry has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues and digestive problems. The plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and modulating the immune system.
